newsitem.title: USA: Vanstar Corp names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Vanstar Corp names chief financial officer.

text.p: Vanstar Corp named Kauko Aronaho as chief financial officer succeeding Jeffrey Rubin.

Aronaho was formerly president of SHL Computer Innovations Inc, an $800 million business operating in Canada, the U.S., and the United Kingdom. Prior to assuming the position as president Aronaho served as SHL's chief financial officer for five years.

Rubin, who was instrumental in completing Vanstar's initial public offering last year, will continue to perform merger and acquisition duties on behalf of Vanstar as a member of Covington Associates, a Boston-based investment banking boutique.
